Harper King: Quick sync brief thread about inline vs summary errors for the new Integrations form. Two options: inline-on-blur with reserved space, or submit-summary banner that links to fields. Thoughts? Nadia Flores: Inline by default. Errors next to fields are faster to fix. For very tall forms we can show a summary after submit. Jon Park: If we use a summary banner it must receive focus and announce count. Also links should anchor to stable ids. Maya Singh: Copy note: prefer explicit messages like "Webhook URL is required" rather than generic "Invalid". Required marker should include sr-only "Required" text. A11yRobot: Checklist: 1) focus moves to banner or first error, 2) inline errors use role=alert, 3) banner uses aria-live polite + tabindex=-1, 4) keyboard-only flow tested. Harper King: Small ARIA example to include in the spec: ```
Webhook URL is required
``` Nadia Flores: Destructive confirm: typed-confirm for deleting integrations that affect billing, otherwise modal + undo toast. Make typed-confirm forgiving (trim + case-insensitive). Jon Park: Implementation note: map server error keys to data-field-id attributes so anchors are deterministic. Maya Singh: Proposed decision: inline-on-blur for touched fields with reserved height; show summary banner after submit for long forms or small viewports; typed-confirm only for high-risk deletes. I'll update the Patterns doc and add Figma variants. Harper King: Thanks closing thread.
